regions.merged_text: God made me to know Him. O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's Heaven begun for the grateful on earth. To treasure aright !-?-! Highest Heaven its worth. - God himself - even here.

regions.merged_text: God bless you Joseph J. O'Donnell - you and yours. I hope this finds all 100% yourselves in the grace of God - smiling after the wonderful rain He sent us, like lillies and roses. I started these cards several days ago but some how or other they are later than intended and far from what I wanted. However, the little German saying "Nichts ..- " consoles me: "Nothing perfect in this world." In other words, no one is here on this side of Heaven fully converted. Thank the good God, He has infinite patience ! - Adored be his Holy Name!
